name: Before-After Transformation
description: Dramatic split-screen or split-reveal before/after format. Subject: room makeovers, fitness results, skill development, budget transformations, or habit changes.
voice_style: reflective, punchy, aspirational — 'I can't believe this is the same [subject]' energy; builds from skepticism to amazement
music_mood: cinematic build, emotional swell, triumphant reveal beat — music mirrors the transformation arc

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: My apartment looked like this six months ago. Hold on — I'll show you what it looks like now.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Split screen: chaotic apartment on left, arrow in middle, person covering right side with hand, teaser close-up of one polished detail
scene_sequence.camera_movement: static split screen composition, slow tilt to detail teaser
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: harsh overhead fluorescent for 'before' side, warm golden lamp light teasing 'after' side
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Dramatic lighting contrast between harsh before and warm after is the visual hook; the hand-covering reveal is a proven TikTok mechanic

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: Before: 900-square-foot studio with no storage, beige walls, landlord-grade furniture, and a mattress on the floor.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Wide shot of messy room, clothes on floor, harsh overhead lighting, cluttered desk, unwashed dishes visible, timestamp 'January 2026'
scene_sequence.camera_movement: slow wide establishing pan across the messy room, revealing each chaotic element
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: harsh flat overhead fluorescent, cool blue-gray tones, slightly desaturated, unflattering shadows
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Make 'before' look genuinely unappealing — the contrast is what makes the reveal satisfying; desaturate slightly for unflattering realism

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: The strategy was simple: one room per month. Month one — I decluttered everything I hadn't touched in 90 days. Month two — I painted the walls.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Boxes being packed and labeled, paint swatches on wall, roller painting smooth strokes, closet transformation time-lapse
scene_sequence.camera_movement: time-lapse pacing for packing, smooth tracking pan across paint swatches, macro close-up on roller strokes
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: natural daylight through window, bright and hopeful tones, paint swatches with clean white card background
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Time-lapse pacing creates satisfying 'process' feeling; clean paint swatch close-ups are highly shareable

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: Month six: the reveal. New lighting — $40 from Amazon. Thrifted furniture — $220 total. Paint — $80. Total spend: $340. Total transformation time: one weekend a month.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Money being counted on counter, new lamp glowing warmly, room tour sweeping through, plants, art, textured throw pillows, beautiful bedding
scene_sequence.camera_movement: slow cinematic room tour: push through doorway, pan across room revealing each detail, tilt up to wall art
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: warm golden lamp light throughout, fairy lights as accent, golden hour color grade, rich saturated tones
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: The reveal is the hero — invest all production value here: slow smooth camera movement, warm rich color grade, every detail should glow

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: Your space shapes your mind. You don't need a big budget — you need a plan. Save this, screenshot the steps, start this weekend.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Person sitting in transformed space looking relaxed, coffee in hand, final wide shot of beautiful room, warm golden hour lighting, 'START THIS WEEKEND' text overlay
scene_sequence.camera_movement: slow pull-back from close-up to final wide room shot
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: golden hour through window, warm orange tones, backlit silhouette option for closing wide shot
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Final wide shot should be aspirational wallpaper-worthy; person-with-coffee close-up gives emotional anchor to the space
